title: David hands over the task to Solomon
description: King David gathers the leaders of Israel in Jerusalem and entrusts his son Solomon with the task of building the house of the Lord. He explains that God himself has chosen Solomon for this work because David, as a man of war, has shed blood. David gives Solomon detailed plans for the porch, the rooms, and the utensils, instructions on the weight of gold and silver, and the division of priests and Levites. He encourages his son to be strong and courageous, for the Lord will be with him until the work is finished.
